name: gemfinder
title: gemfinder · narrative gems, crypto + stocks
description: Scans keyless public feeds (CoinGecko trending + category momentum, DexScreener boosts and new tokens, reddit mentions via ApeWisdom, Yahoo Finance trending and small-cap/day-gainer screens, Hacker News buzz) for crypto tokens and stocks a hot narrative is starting to carry. Merges per ticker, heats 13 narratives, and ranks candidates by an attention score (attention, velocity, narrative, momentum, size) with reasons and risk flags. Stdlib-only, one SQLite cache. Attention, not a forecast.
state: ~/.mod/gemfinder/cache.db (raw HTTP bodies by url) · ~/.mod/gemfinder/scans.jsonl (every scan's picks + price)

narratives.docs: ?asset= -> heat 0-100 per narrative for crypto and stocks, with raw drivers

sources.docs: Candidate sources and what each contributes
